observations: Photo 0: A beige and black standing cooker with four control knobs on the front panel. The top lid is closed, and the oven door is open, showing a single wire rack inside. The surface shows signs of rust and wear. A box labeled 'MILTON' is visible behind it.

Photo 1: Same cooker from a slightly different angle, showing the same front panel with four knobs. The oven door is open, revealing the interior. The surface is dusty and shows some discoloration. The background includes a yellow box and a wooden chair.

Photo 2: The top of the cooker with a four-burner gas hob. The burners are visibly rusted and clogged. The top lid is open, showing the underside. The front panel has four knobs, with the leftmost knob appearing to be a control for the hob. The oven door is open, showing the interior. The background includes a fan and other household items.

risks.proof: A close-up photo of the burners showing the extent of rust and clogging, and a video of the burners being lit and functioning.

risks.risk: Electric oven may not heat or may be damaged internally.
risks.proof: A video showing the oven being turned on and heating up, or a photo of the oven interior with a thermometer or indicator light.

risks.risk: The cooker may have electrical faults or wiring issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video of the cooker being turned on and off, showing all controls working and the oven heating up.

risks.risk: The oven door seal may be damaged or worn, leading to poor heat retention or gas leaks.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the oven door seal and hinges, showing no gaps or damage.

proof_requests: A close-up photo of the gas burners showing rust and clogging.
A video of the burners being lit and functioning.
A video of the oven being turned on and heating up.
A close-up photo of the oven door seal and hinges.
A photo of the control panel showing all knobs and switches working.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
